                            (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                            (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (u : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),

                                        (fun n =>
                                          ∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                            ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                              Breakdown.Coercive.splitRight
                                                (fun σ y ι =>
                                                  Breakdown.Coercive.pieceRest m h w W (u (φ n))
                                                    (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))
                                                    (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u (φ n))) ι σ y)
                                                (fun σ y =>
                                                  Breakdown.Coercive.pieceBlock m W (u (φ n))
                                                    (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))
                                                    (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u (φ n))) σ y)
                                                (Breakdown.stretchForm W (u (φ n)) (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))) σ y)
                                        Filter.atTop
                                        (nhds

                                            ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                              Breakdown.Coercive.splitRight
                                                (fun σ y ι => Breakdown.Coercive.pieceRest m h w W v G H ι σ y)
                                                (fun σ y => Breakdown.Coercive.pieceBlock m W v G H σ y)
                                                (Breakdown.stretchForm W v G) σ y)) ∧
                                      ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 1),
                                        ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          Breakdown.Coercive.splitLeft
                                              (fun σ y ι => Breakdown.Coercive.piecePos m P v G ι σ y)
                                              (fun σ y ι => Breakdown.Coercive.pieceRest m h w W v G H ι σ y)
                                              (fun σ y => Breakdown.Coercive.pieceBlock m W v G H σ y)
                                              (Breakdown.stretchForm W v G) σ y ≤
                                            Filter.liminf
                                              (fun n =>
                                                Breakdown.Coercive.splitLeft
                                                  (fun σ y ι =>
                                                    Breakdown.Coercive.piecePos m P (u (φ n))
                                                      (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n))) ι σ y)
                                                  (fun σ y ι =>
                                                    Breakdown.Coercive.pieceRest m h w W (u (φ n))
                                                      (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))
                                                      (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u (φ n))) ι σ y)
                                                  (fun σ y =>
                                                    Breakdown.Coercive.pieceBlock m W (u (φ n))
                                                      (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))
                                                      (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u (φ n))) σ y)
                                                  (Breakdown.stretchForm W (u (φ n)) (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))) σ

              m.IsAdmissible P h w W w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
                (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
                    (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
                      (∃ D,
                          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                            ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
                        (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                          ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                            (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                            (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                            (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (u : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                              Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothApproximation P v G H g u →
                                ∃ φ,

                                    Filter.Tendsto
                                        (fun n =>
                                          ∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                            ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                              Breakdown.Coercive.splitRight

                                                    (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))
                                                    (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u (φ n))) ι σ y)

                                                    (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))
                                                    (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u (φ n))) σ y)
                                                (Breakdown.stretchForm W (u (φ n)) (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))) σ y)

                                                      (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n))) ι σ y)
                                                  (fun σ y ι =>

                                                      (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))

                                                  (fun σ y =>

                      (W σ y).ofLp i =

                      ↑((Breakdown.axialRot (-φ)
                                (((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (W (σ + τ))) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))

                        ↑(Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv (0, 0) (Breakdown.secondDerivField W) σ y (b, j, a)).re +

            ∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM) (P : ℝ) (h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds)
              (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
              (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},

                (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
                    (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →

                          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                            ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
                        (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                          (∀ (i : Fin k),
                              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                              (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                                ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                  (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                                  (H :
                                    ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                                  (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)

                                    Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothApproximation P v G H g u →
                                      ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F M : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                                          Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                            (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →

                                                      Filter.Tendsto
                                                        (fun n =>
                                                          m.multiplierGap P w act (u n) (Breakdown.gradField (u n))
                                                            (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u n)) κ
                                                            (fun σ y =>
                                                              Breakdown.Coercive.smoothRight P W (u n) σ y +

declarations.name: Breakdown.Coercive.Internal.PieceAbsorb.eps_density_identity
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM) (P : ℝ) (h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds) (β : Fin nE)
  (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space) (xc xo x1 x0 : ℝ),
  Breakdown.Coercive.pieceEpsDensity m P h β ι y xc xo x1 x0 -
      Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.epsP β).modes ι) * (m.epsP β).wt y *
          |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι| *
        xo ^ 2 =
    -(Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (0 < (m.epsP β).wt y + Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y) *
                  (m.epsP β).share1 y *
                (Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.epsP β).modes ι) * xc ^ 2) +
              (((m.epsP β).wt y * (m.epsP β).speed y + Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y) ^ 2 /
                        (4 * (m.epsP β).share1 y) +
                      (m.epsP β).wt y * (|(m.epsP β).frame| + 1 / 2 * h.supVort y) +
                    (m.epsP β).wt y * h.supGradVort y * (m.epsP β).len y / 2 +
                  (m.epsP β).wt y * h.supVort y * (m.epsP β).t0 y / 2) *
                (Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.epsP β).modes ι) * xo ^ 2) +
            (m.epsP β).wt y * h.supVort y / (2 * (m.epsP β).t0 y) *
              (Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.epsP β).modes ι) * x1 ^ 2) +
          (m.epsP β).wt y * h.supGradVort y / (2 * (m.epsP β).len y) *
            (Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.epsP β).modes ι) * x0 ^ 2)) -
      (Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.epsP β).modes ι) *
                    ((m.epsP β).wt y ^ 2 * (m.epsP β).scale y / (4 * (m.epsP β).share2 y)) *
                  Breakdown.PieceWeights.inward h (m.epsP β).modes h.ampW ι y *
                xo ^ 2 +
              Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (0 < (m.epsP β).wt y) * ((m.epsP β).share2 y / (m.epsP β).scale y) *
                  Breakdown.PieceWeights.outward h (m.epsP β).modes h.ampW ι y *
                xc ^ 2 +
            (Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.epsP β).modes ι) *
                    ((m.epsP β).wt y * (m.epsP β).t1 y / 2) *
                  Breakdown.PieceWeights.inward h (m.epsP β).modes h.ampGradW ι y *
                xo ^ 2 +
              (m.epsP β).wt y / (2 * (m.epsP β).t1 y) *
                  Breakdown.PieceWeights.outward h (m.epsP β).modes h.ampGradW ι y *
                xo ^ 2) +
          (Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.epsP β).modes ι) *
                  ((m.epsP β).wt y * (m.epsP β).t2 y / 2) *
                Breakdown.PieceWeights.inward h (m.epsP β).modes h.ampGradVort ι y *
              xo ^ 2 +
            (m.epsP β).wt y / (2 * (m.epsP β).t2 y) *
                Breakdown.PieceWeights.outward h (m.epsP β).modes h.ampGradVort ι y *
              x0 ^ 2) +
        (Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.epsP β).modes ι) *
                ((m.epsP β).wt y * (m.epsP β).t3 y / 2) *
              Breakdown.PieceWeights.inward h (m.epsP β).modes h.ampVort ι y *
            xo ^ 2 +
          (m.epsP β).wt y / (2 * (m.epsP β).t3 y) * Breakdown.PieceWeights.outward h (m.epsP β).modes h.ampVort ι y *
            x1 ^ 2))

              (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
              m.IsAdmissible P h w W w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
                (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
                    (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
                      (∃ D,
                          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                            ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
                        (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                          (∀ (i : Fin k),
                              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →

                              (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →

                                  (H :
                                    ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)

                                          Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                            (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →

                                                m.IsMultiplierField v G H M →

  {Pos₀ Rest₀ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → ℤ × ℤ → ℝ} {Blk₀ J₀ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → ℝ},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), Breakdown.Coercive.IsSplitLowerBound (X n) (Pos n) (Rest n) (Blk n) (J n)) →
    Filter.Tendsto X Filter.atTop (nhds X₀) →
      Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n =>
            ∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
              ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.Coercive.splitRight (Rest n) (Blk n) (J n) σ y)
          Filter.atTop
          (nhds
            (∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1, ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.Coercive.splitRight Rest₀ Blk₀ J₀ σ y)) →
        ∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1, ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.Coercive.splitRight Rest₀ Blk₀ J₀ σ y < ⊤ →
          (∀ (n : ℕ),
              ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 1),
                AEMeasurable (fun y => Breakdown.Coercive.splitLeft (Pos n) (Rest n) (Blk n) (J n) σ y)
                  MeasureTheory.volume) →
            (∀ (n : ℕ),
                AEMeasurable
                  (fun σ => ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.Coercive.splitLeft (Pos n) (Rest n) (Blk n) (J n) σ y)
                  (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 1))) →
              (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 1),
                  ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                    Breakdown.Coercive.splitLeft Pos₀ Rest₀ Blk₀ J₀ σ y ≤
                      Filter.liminf (fun n => Breakdown.Coercive.splitLeft (Pos n) (Rest n) (Blk n) (J n) σ y)
                        Filter.atTop) →
                Breakdown.Coercive.IsSplitLowerBound X₀ Pos₀ Rest₀ Blk₀ J₀
